title: Validate with attributes
hints: `p.GetCustomAttribute<RangeAttribute>()` returns the attribute object (with the `Min` and `Max` you stored in its constructor) or `null` when the property does not have it.
Patterns keep the checks short: `value is string s && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)`, and `p.GetCustomAttribute<RangeAttribute>() is { } range && value is int n`.
